questions.question: The oldest international trophy in sport, first won in 1851 and still contested today, is awarded in which sport?
questions.explanation: The America's Cup was first won by the yacht America off the Isle of Wight in 1851, decades before the first modern Olympics or the first football World Cup.

questions.question: Čím tradičně krájely české babičky houskový knedlík, aby se při krájení nezmáčkl?

posts.caption:
Road trip round, part 1.

How many did you get right? Comment your score.

Trubbo, trivia you answer out loud. Coming soon to the App Store, link in bio.

#trivia #quiz #popculture #movies #roadtrip

questions.question: Which 2025 vampire film set an all-time record at the 2026 Oscars with sixteen nominations?
questions.explanation: The bloodsoaked thriller out-nominated every film in Academy history and took home four statuettes on the night.

questions.question: Which rapper became Spotify's most-streamed artist in a single day of 2026 after dropping three surprise albums at once?
questions.explanation: Releasing three albums with no warning flooded playlists worldwide and handed him the biggest streaming day of any artist that year.

questions.question: Which actor was working as a carpenter before being cast as Han Solo in the original Star Wars?
questions.explanation: Ford said he was quite surprised to be offered the part. His carpentry skills reportedly helped him land studio work where he was noticed.

questions.question: Which continent contains more sovereign countries than any other?
questions.explanation: Africa has 54 internationally recognised countries, comfortably ahead of Europe and Asia.

questions.question: In 1952, which world-famous physicist was offered the presidency of Israel and politely turned it down?
questions.explanation: The offer came from Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion after the first president died, and Einstein replied that he lacked the aptitude for dealing with people and official functions.

questions.question: On a standard six-sided die, the numbers on any two opposite faces always add up to what?
questions.explanation: One sits opposite six, two opposite five and three opposite four, so every pair of opposite faces totals seven.

questions.question: The world's most famous restaurant star ratings are awarded by a guide that was launched in 1900 to sell which product?
questions.explanation: The Michelin brothers gave the guide away free to French motorists, hoping that more driving would wear out more tyres.

questions.question: Vo filmovom muzikáli Wicked: For Good z novembra 2025 hrá dobrú čarodejnicu Glindu známa popová speváčka. Ktorá?
questions.explanation: Ariana Grande si Glindu zopakovala z prvého dielu Wicked, zatiaľ čo Elphabu opäť stvárnila Cynthia Erivo.

questions.question: Ktorý hollywoodsky herec v roku 2026 opäť prepožičal hlas Mariovi vo filme The Super Mario Galaxy Movie?
questions.explanation: Pratt nahovoril Maria už v prvom filme z roku 2023, ktorý celosvetovo zarobil vyše 1,3 miliardy dolárov. Novú postavu Rosalinu v pokračovaní nahovorila Brie Larson.

questions.question: Slávna slovenská pieseň Hej, Slováci má rovnakú melódiu ako štátna hymna jednej našej susednej krajiny. Ktorej?
questions.explanation: Samo Tomášik napísal svoj text na melódiu poľskej piesne Mazurek Dąbrowského, ktorá sa neskôr stala poľskou hymnou. Ten istý nápev dlhé roky slúžil aj ako hymna Juhoslávie.

questions.question: Ktorá slovenská speváčka reprezentovala Slovensko na Eurovízii v roku 2010 s piesňou Horehronie?
questions.explanation: Pieseň sa doma stala obrovským hitom, no v Osle sa zo semifinále do finálového večera nedostala.

questions.question: Ktorý obchodný reťazec má na Slovensku zďaleka najviac predajní, oveľa viac než Lidl, Tesco či Kaufland?
questions.explanation: COOP Jednota má na Slovensku vyše dvetisíc predajní, lebo stojí takmer v každej dedine. Veľké zahraničné reťazce majú len zlomok tohto počtu, hoci ich obchody sú oveľa väčšie.

questions.question: V Jasnej sa dá lanovkami prejsť zo severnej strany Nízkych Tatier až na južnú. Cez ktorý vrch vás vyvezú?
questions.explanation: Lanovky vyvezú lyžiarov až pod vrchol Chopka vo výške vyše 2000 metrov. Odtiaľ sa dá zlyžovať na druhú stranu hôr, takže Jasná je najväčším lyžiarskym strediskom na Slovensku.

questions.question: Ktoré slovenské mesto sa pre svoje bane prezýva „zlaté mesto“ a dodnes sa v ňom razia slovenské euromince?
questions.explanation: Kremnické zlaté dukáty patrili v stredoveku k najcennejším minciam v Európe. Tamojšia mincovňa razí peniaze nepretržite už takmer sedem storočí, takže euro vo vašej peňaženke pochádza z rovnakej dielne ako dukáty kráľov.
